$comment: The driven-session permission policy for opencode (vogt WI-932), the opencode half of WI-926. The engine hands it to every engine-launched opencode session in the default posture as OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT, which opencode layers over the user's own config without changing it. Routine tools are allowed so an unattended session never stalls at a prompt. Destructive, shared-resource and secret-exposing commands are DENIED rather than asked, so the agent reports itself blocked instead of waiting for nobody. Unlike Claude Code's auto mode, opencode matches command patterns and cannot judge context, so this list is coarser. A deployment replaces it with ENGINE_AGENT_OPENCODE_CONFIG, for example to allow merging its agents' own PRs.
